title: Circular fund flow — Meridian Holdings India Pvt Ltd (SBI 30765432189)
description: Suspected layering operation: ₹1.85 Cr transferred by Meridian Holdings India Pvt Ltd (SBI, IFSC SBIN0001187) via RTGS through Aarav Traders Pvt Ltd (HDFC, IFSC HDFC0001235) and Sunrise Finance Pvt Ltd (UCO Bank, IFSC UCBA0002341), returning ₹1.79 Cr to originator within 36 hours. Net extraction: ₹5.5 L (2.97%).
explanation: The 3-hop RTGS chain with a 2.97% extraction spread is consistent with money laundering layering under PMLA Section 3. Meridian Holdings India Pvt Ltd is the suspected primary controller. The use of RTGS (high-value, immediate settlement) with a circular return pattern is a known red flag indicator recognised by FIU-IND in its STR guidance.
recommended_action: Freeze accounts 30765432189 (SBI), 50100421836529 (HDFC), and 0230014781923 (UCO Bank). File STR with FIU-IND via FINnet portal within 7 working days of this report. Notify MLRO immediately.

Escalated to MLRO for STR review. Legal hold placed on Meridian Holdings account.

title: Synthetic identity — Horizon Ventures India Pvt Ltd (Kotak 1634087654321)
description: Kotak corporate current account 1634087654321 (Horizon Ventures India Pvt Ltd, Jaipur) opened 57 days ago. GSTIN 08AABCH9012G1Z5 found inactive. First transaction is a ₹22.5 L UPI credit to a flagged Paytm VPA (rjtraders2026@paytm, 33 days old). No prior debit history. CIN U65999RJ2026PTC089234 shows company incorporated Feb 2026.
explanation: The combination of recent incorporation (57 days), inactive GSTIN, and first transaction being a large UPI credit to a newly-created VPA strongly indicates a synthetic business identity being used for immediate round-tripping. Consistent with known modus operandi flagged in RBI Master Direction on KYC 2016 Section 16.
recommended_action: Initiate Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD). Request GSTIN reactivation proof, latest ITR, and audited balance sheet within 15 days. Place account under 30-day monitoring. If documents unsatisfactory, escalate for closure.

title: Mule network — Aditi Borse Enterprises disbursement ring (Axis 917030187654321)
description: Axis Bank proprietorship current account 917030187654321 (Aditi Borse Enterprises, Bengaluru) executed 3 RTGS transfers of ₹98 L each on 01–02 Apr 2026 to newly-opened personal accounts in Punjab (P&S Bank), Odisha (UCO Bank), and Assam (UCO Bank) — all accounts <30 days old. A 4th NEFT of ₹28.2 L sent to Axis Hyderabad (SGP Holdings Pvt Ltd). Combined disbursement: ₹3.22 Cr in 25 hours.
explanation: The simultaneous disbursement to 3 newly-opened personal accounts across geographically distant states is the hallmark of an organised mule network used to fragment and rapidly disburse proceeds of crime. The sub-threshold structure (₹98 L each, just below CTR automatic flagging) and the cross-state geographic spread maximise distance from the originator while minimising individual transaction monitoring. This meets the threshold for mandatory STR filing under PMLA Section 12(1)(b) and potential reporting under Section 12A.
recommended_action: Immediately freeze Axis account 917030187654321 (Aditi Borse). Place legal hold on beneficiary accounts: 02381876543210 (P&S Bank, Ludhiana), 0230029876541 (UCO Bank, Bhubaneswar), 0230038765430 (UCO Bank, Guwahati). File urgent STR with FIU-IND. Notify law enforcement under PMLA Section 12A if funds not yet disbursed by mule recipients.
